rationale: The interpreter makes an unsupported assumption about rounding tie-breaking and does not capture the inherent ambiguity regarding tie-breaking in the ticket, leaving the required behavior undefined.

findings.description: The interpreter assumes a tie-breaking rule for rounding, which is not specified in the ticket.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported assumption and require clarification on tie-breaking.

findings.description: The ticket does not define how to handle rounding ties (e.g., exactly halfway between increments), leaving the behavior ambiguous.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the rounding tie-breaking policy.
